turns.doctor_question: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Well, it's nice to meet you too. I'm here because... my sleep has just become completely unmoored lately. 

At first, a little while ago, I was waking up after maybe two or three hours of sleep, but I'd get right up and start drafting plans. I actually felt completely ready to go. But now it's shifted. Now I just lie awake for hours before dawn. My stomach gets all tight, and I just... I don't get any sense of rest at all anymore.

turns.doctor_question: During that time when you were sleeping only two or three hours and still felt ready to go, did you feel unusually energized or unusually irritable?
turns.patient_response:
Well, honestly, it was a bit of both. For weeks I felt... almost brilliantly optimistic. It was as if every obstacle in my way was just completely trivial. 

But at the same time, if anyone questioned me or my plans, I got very irritable. I snapped at them. It honestly felt like they were trying to sabotage the only sensible man in the room.
